title: Improve Request Port Extraction in ServeCommand
desc: Patched port handling in ServeCommand.php to prevent Artisan command failures when the port string is non-trivial.

title: beforeCommit honors ShouldQueueAfterCommit
desc: beforeCommit now executes correctly even when the job uses the ShouldQueueAfterCommit contract — closes the gap between transactional intent and queue lifecycle.

title: Security: previousPath() can return external URL
desc: Reported and patched a security vuln where previousPath() could leak external URLs back to the caller. Fix discussed; ultimately superseded.

title: retryUntil() return type → DateTimeInterface
desc: Doc fix — retryUntil() returns DateTimeInterface, not concrete DateTime. Small, but pays back every time someone reads the queue chapter.

title: Boost: queue-job retryUntil() type
desc: Corrected return-type docs in queue-job guidelines so Boost's static suggestions match the framework's contract.

title: Boost: internal refactor
desc: Refactor pass on Boost internals — for clarity, consistency.

title: Request Analytics: 3 PRs
desc: Three PRs landed (#79, #80, #81) — feature work and quality-of-life fixes for the request analytics package.
